newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS MEDICAL-PALEO FALIRO CLINIC STARTS TRADE MON.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS MEDICAL-PALEO FALIRO CLINIC STARTS TRADE MON.

text.p: Shares of the Athens Medical Clinic at Paleo Faliro will start trading at the Athens bourse's small cap market on Monday, Athens Medical Centre financial consultant Yannis Andrikopoulos told Reuters.
Investors will be able to pick up their share certificates from the recent IPO on Thursday, he said.
The Athens Medical Clinic - Paleo Faliro is a subsidiary of main market listing, Athens Medical Centre.
It recently issued 317,000 new registered ordinary shares at 1,900 drachmas each and raised 602 million drachmas, said Andrikopoulos.
The IPO proceeds will finance the purchase of new high-tech medical equipment, construction of new facilities and participation in the Inter-Balkan Medical Centre in Thessaloniki.
The IPO issue was oversubscribed 57 times, he said.
Bank of Piraeus was the main underwriter and issue advisor and Alpha Credit Bank , Agricultural Bank and N.D. Devletoglou Securities, Sarros Brokerage and Sigma Securities were co-underwriters.
